# 16 ActiveCampaign Alternatives for Serious Marketers (2026 Picks)

Campaign Monitor - Dec 2, 2025

![](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/best-activecampaign-alternatives.webp)

While ActiveCampaign offers powerful automation capabilities, many online reviews suggest that users struggle with the platform’s complex interface, escalating costs, and limited features.

We know we have a horse in this race, so we made sure to do the homework. We’ve analyzed thousands of real user reviews across G2, Capterra, Reddit, and beyond to lay out where each tool genuinely shines (and falls short).

We’ve compared 16 leading [email marketing tools](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/) to find solutions that might be a better fit for your specific needs. Ready? Let’s dive in.

## **(TL;DR) ActiveCampaign alternatives at a glance**

| **Tool** | **Best For** | **Key Advantage** | **Starting Price** | **Rating** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| **Zoho Campaigns** | Zoho ecosystem users | Seamless integration with Zoho CRM and apps | Free plan; starts at $4/month | 4.4/5 (700+ reviews) |

**Note:** The features, pricing, and details mentioned for each product are as of December 2025, and may have changed since then.

## Where ActiveCampaign falls short, according to reviewers

ActiveCampaign is undeniably a robust marketing automation platform with impressive capabilities. However, after analyzing **hundreds of reviews from G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, and Reddit, several recurring issues kept surfacing:**

- **Complex interface with a steep learning curve** that can overwhelm users without technical expertise
- **Escalating costs as contact lists grow**, creating budget challenges for scaling businesses
- **Customer support delays** with some users reporting days of waiting for resolution
- **Limited customization options** for templates compared to more design-focused alternatives
- **Overwhelming feature set** that many users pay for but never fully utilize

## **1) Campaign Monitor – The \#1 ActiveCampaign alternative in the market right now**

4.7/5 (1000+ reviews)

![campaign monitor homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/campaign-monitor-homepage.webp)

Campaign Monitor delivers powerful features and intuitive design that makes email marketing accessible to everyone. With its drag-and-drop email builder, prebuilt automated journeys, and straightforward yet effective segmentation capabilities, it’s ideal for businesses that want professional results without the complexity.

### **Campaign Monitor vs. ActiveCampaign: Key differences**

| **Feature** | **Campaign Monitor** | **ActiveCampaign** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **User Sentiment** | 4.7/5 (1000+ reviews) | 4.4/5 (1000+ reviews) |
| **Deliverability Tools** | Access to deliverability experts, inbox previews and spam testing | Domain authentication, spam checks, and campaign previews (no access to deliverability specialists) |
| **Ease of Use** | Consistently praised as intuitive | A steep learning curve as frequently noted in online reviews. |
| **User Loyalty** | Many users report 10+ years of usage | Strong loyalty among technical teams and developers |
| **Delivery rate** | 99% delivery rate | High delivery rates (exact number isn’t shared) |
| **Optimization tools** | A/B testing with insights & goals (increase open-rates, click-through rates, and visits to a URL) | Content optimizer, predictive content |

### **Key features**

- **Drag-and-Drop Email Builder**: Create visually stunning emails in minutes with an intuitive interface that requires zero coding knowledge.
- **Prebuilt Automated Journeys**: Leverage prebuilt journeys (welcome series, abandoned cart, anniversaries, and events) to save time, boost engagement, and drive conversions.
- **Dynamic Content**: Personalize emails by showing different content to different subscribers within the same campaign, increasing relevance and engagement.
- **A/B Testing Engine**: Test subject lines, content blocks, or CTAs to optimize results based on real user behavior, with the ability to set goals such as increasing open rates, click-through rates, and visits to a URL.
- **24/5 Global Support**: Global support via multiple channels via multiple channels (email support on all tiers, phone support on premium)

### **What else can you do with Campaign Monitor?**

Beyond email marketing, Campaign Monitor offers SMS marketing capabilities for customers in the US, Canada, Australia, and UK. For agencies, Campaign Monitor offers a range of features to simplify client management, including client dashboards, multi-account access, and custom user roles.

These tools, along with performance tracking and the ability to manage all clients from a single interface, help agencies optimize their workflow and campaign performance.

### **Campaign Monitor has a free plan, but pricing starts at** **$12 USD/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** | **Best For** |

| **Premier** | Starts at $159 USD/month | Unlimited automated emails, engagement segments, send time optimization, email section locking, advanced link tracking | Large businesses |

## **2) Mailchimp – Multi-channel marketing tool**

4.4/5 (5000+ reviews)

![mailchimp homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/mailchimp-homepage.webp)

Mailchimp has evolved from a simple email service provider to a comprehensive marketing platform that includes email, website building, social media, and more. Its strength lies in providing small businesses with all the tools they need in one place, though its interface can sometimes feel cluttered compared to more focused alternatives.

### **Key features**

- **Comprehensive Marketing Hub**: Access email, landing pages, social media, digital ads, and website building all from one platform.
- **AI-Powered Tools**: Generate content, design assets, and optimize campaigns with Mailchimp’s expanding suite of AI features.
- **Website & Landing Page Builder**: Create SEO-optimized, mobile-responsive websites with unlimited pages and bandwidth without additional tools.
- **Customer Journey Builder**: Design automated workflows with 60+ triggers based on user behavior, purchase history, or engagement.
- **Predictive Analytics**: Leverage customer lifetime value and purchase likelihood metrics to target your most valuable audience segments.

### **Mailchimp has a free plan, but pricing starts at $13/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Free** | $0/month | 1000 monthly email sends, limited pre-built email templates & creative assistant |
| **Essentials** | $13/month | 5,000 email sends, popup forms, email scheduling |
| **Standard** | $20/month for 500 contacts | Everything in Essentials + custom reports, 6,000 sends/month, SMS and MMS add-on, advanced segmentation |
| **Premium** | $350/month | Everything in Standard + unlimited users, 150,000 sends/month, phone & priority support |

### **Considerations before going with Mailchimp**

Mailchimp’s pricing structure has become increasingly expensive over recent years, with the Premium plan jumping to $350/month. Advanced tools like branching automation and multivariate testing are restricted to higher-tier plans, limiting functionality for budget-conscious users.

Additionally, the platform imposes strict automation limits on the Essentials plan (only 4 journey points), forcing upgrades for more complex workflows.

## **3) Brevo – Budget-friendly alternative**

4.5/5 (2000+ reviews)

![brevo homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/brevo-homepage.webp)

Formerly known as Sendinblue, Brevo offers one of the most generous free plans in the industry with unlimited contacts and 300 emails per day. Its strength lies in providing affordable access to email, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat marketing in a unified platform.

### **Key features**

- **Unlimited Contacts**: Even the free plan allows unlimited contacts, charging only based on email volume rather than list size.
- **Multi-Channel Communication**: Integrate email, SMS, WhatsApp, and live chat in one platform for cohesive customer interactions.
- **AI-Powered Tools**: Generate content, optimize send times, and summarize chat conversations automatically with Aura AI.
- **Universal Inbox**: Centralize communications from email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram, and live chat in one interface for streamlined customer service.
- **Customer Data Platform**: Unify data across marketing, sales, and service for comprehensive customer profiles and segmentation.

### **Brevo has a free plan, but pricing starts at $9/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Free** | $0/month | Unlimited contacts, 300 emails/day, email support, SMS marketing (pay-as-you-go), basic features |
| **Starter** | $9/month | 5,000 emails/month, no daily sending limit, A/B testing, no Brevo logo(add on) |
| **Business** | $18/month | 5,000 emails/month, marketing automation, predictive sending, landing pages, A/B testing. |
| **Enterprise** | Custom pricing | Unlimited contacts, custom volume of emails, priority support, exclusive features, advanced integrations |

### **Considerations before going with Brevo**

Some advanced features like A/B testing and multi-user access require higher-tier plans or add-ons. SMS and WhatsApp pricing varies widely depending on destination countries, which can lead to unpredictable costs.

## **4) Klaviyo – Good for ecommerce brands**

4.6/5 (1000+ reviews)

![klaviyo homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/klaviyo-homepage.webp)

Klaviyo specializes in ecommerce marketing with deep integrations for online stores and powerful predictive analytics. It’s designed for brands that want to leverage customer data for highly personalized, revenue-generating campaigns across email, SMS, and mobile apps.

### **Key features**

- **Unified Customer Data**: Build comprehensive customer profiles that combine purchase history, browsing behavior, and engagement data.
- **Predictive Analytics**: Forecast customer lifetime value, churn risk, and next purchase date to optimize targeting and offers.
- **Multi-Channel Orchestration**: Coordinate messaging across email, SMS, and mobile push notifications from a single platform.
- **Product Recommendations**: Automatically suggest relevant products based on browsing or purchase history to drive repeat sales.
- **Reviews Platform**: Collect and display customer reviews for products with pre-built email flows for review solicitation.

### **Klaviyo has a free plan, but pricing starts at $45/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Free** | $0/month | Up to 250 contacts, 500 email sends/month, 150/mo SMS credits, email support (first 60 days) |
| **Email** | $45/month | 15,000 Emails per month, 350+ built-in integrations, built-in reporting dashboards, generative AI |
| **Email & SMS** | $65/month | Everything in Email + 1250 SMS/MMS credits/month, multi-channel segmentation |

### **Considerations before going with Klaviyo**

Klaviyo’s platform is heavily optimized for e-commerce businesses, making it less suitable for service-based companies or B2B organizations. The platform’s reviews and advanced data platform features require add-on purchases beyond the base pricing.

4.1/5 (6000+ reviews)

![constant contract homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/constant-contract-homepage.webp)

Constant Contact focuses on simplicity and accessibility, making it ideal for small businesses and nonprofits that want straightforward email marketing without a steep learning curve. Its standout feature is built-in event management, setting it apart from most competitors.

### **Key features**

- **Event Marketing**: Host events, sell tickets, and process payments via Stripe or PayPal directly within the platform.
- **AI Copy Generator**: Automatically draft messaging based on campaign goals to accelerate content creation.
- **Social Media Integration**: Schedule and post content to Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn alongside email campaigns.
- **Beginner-Friendly Interface**: Navigate an intuitive platform designed specifically for users with limited technical expertise.

### **Considerations before going with Constant Contact**

Constant Contact offers limited automation capabilities in its lower-tier plans, with the Lite plan including just one automation template. Advanced reporting and unlimited segmentation require the Premium plan, which is significantly more expensive.

## **6) SendGrid – Developer-friendly marketing platform**

4/5 (300+ reviews)

![sendgrid homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/sendgrid-homepage.webp)

SendGrid, a Twilio company, offers a developer-first approach to email marketing with powerful APIs and reliable delivery infrastructure. It’s ideal for technical teams that need programmatic control over their email communications and transactional messages.

### **Key features**

- **Industry-Leading Deliverability**: Benefit from 99% inbox placement rates and 1.9-second median delivery speed.
- **Robust APIs and SDKs**: Integrate email functionality directly into applications with well-documented code libraries.
- **Dynamic Templates**: Create reusable email designs with Handlebars syntax for advanced personalization.
- **Dedicated IPs**: Maintain sender reputation with dedicated IP addresses (available on higher-tier plans).
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Monitor delivery metrics, engagement, and performance with comprehensive dashboards.

### **SendGrid has a free plan, but pricing starts at $19.95/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Free** | $0/month | 100 emails/day, basic analytics, SMTP relay |
| **Essentials** | $19.95/month | 50,000 – 100,000 emails/month, analytics & deliverability optimization |
| **Pro** | $89.95/month | 100,000 – 2,500,000 emails/month, 5 event webhook, dedicated IPs included, subuser management, 2,500 email validation |
| **Premier** | Custom pricing | Custom email volume, dedicated IPs, priority support, single sign-on (SSO), 1,000 additional teammates |

### **Considerations before going with SendGrid**

SendGrid’s interface prioritizes functionality over user-friendliness, making it challenging for non-technical marketers. Many key features like automation, dedicated IPs, and validation are only available on higher-priced plans.

**Read next: [We Compared 12+ User-Friendly SendGrid Alternatives](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/blog/email-marketing/sendgrid-alternatives/)**

## **7) GetResponse – Marketing platform for content creators**

4.3/5 (700+ reviews)

![getresponse homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/getresponse-homepage.webp)

GetResponse combines traditional email marketing with webinars, sales funnels, and course creation tools. It’s particularly well-suited for businesses that want to monetize knowledge through online courses and membership sites.

### **Key features**

- **AI Course Creator**: Structure courses, modules, and quizzes automatically from simple topic descriptions.
- **Webinar Functionality**: Host live and on-demand webinars directly within the platform without additional software.
- **Conversion Funnels**: Build complete sales processes with integrated pages, forms, emails, and payment processing.
- **Ecommerce Tools**: Recover abandoned carts and create promo codes for your online store.
- **AI Campaign Generator**: Create complete campaigns including landing pages, emails, and newsletters from simple prompts.

### **Pricing starts at $19/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Email Marketing** | $19/month (1000 contacts) | AI email generator, unlimited autoresponders, AI landing pages, custom automation workflow |
| **Marketer** | $59/month (1000 contacts) | Newsletter revenue statistics, promo codes, email delivery scheduling, segmentation, sales funnels |
| **Creator** | $69/month (1000 contacts) | AI course creator, up to 500 students, mobile app for students, quizzes and certificates, creator profile, premium newsletters |
| **Max** | Custom pricing | Premium, priority support, dedicated IP address, single sign-on (SSO), SMS marketing, mobile push notifications, AI product recommendations |

### **Considerations before going with GetResponse**

The platform has a learning curve for advanced features like funnels and courses. SMS marketing costs extra and is only available on the Enterprise tier, limiting multi-channel capabilities for smaller businesses.

## **8) ConvertKit (now Kit) – Good for independent creators**

4.4/5 (200+ reviews)

![convertkit homepage](https://www.campaignmonitor.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/convertkit-homepage.webp)

Kit (formerly ConvertKit) is designed specifically for independent creators like writers, podcasters, and artists. It focuses on growing and monetizing audiences through newsletters, digital products, and creator recommendations.

### **Key features**

- **Creator Network**: Grow organically by appearing in other creators’ sign-up flows or through paid recommendations.
- **Integrated Commerce**: Sell digital products, subscriptions, and accept one-off donations without third-party tools.
- **Visual Automation Builder**: Design subscriber journeys with an intuitive, visual workflow editor.
- **Single List Management**: Avoid duplicate billing with a tag-based system instead of multiple lists.
- **Newsletter Referral System**: Encourage subscribers to share your content with built-in referral tracking.

### **ConvertKit has a free plan, but pricing starts at $29/month**

| **Plan** | **Price** | **Features** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Newsletter** | $0/month | Up to 1,000 subscribers, unlimited landing pages and forms, sell digital products and subscriptions |
| **Creator** | $29/month for 1,000 subscribers | Unlimited visual automations & email Sequences, free & paid recommendations, smart recommendations, apps, RSS campaigns, polls |
| **Creator Pro** | $59/month for 1,000 subscribers | Facebook custom audiences, newsletter referral, subscriber engagement scoring, deliverability reporting, insights, 24/7 priority support |

### **Considerations before going with ConvertKit**

The platform is heavily focused on individual creators and may lack some features needed by larger teams or businesses. The learning curve for power users can be steep, as features like the Commerce and Sponsor Network require time to master.

- **Landing Page Builder**: Create conversion-focused pages with 100+ templates and integrated forms.
- **Web Push Notifications**: Re-engage site visitors with browser-based notifications alongside email.

Moosend offers competitive pricing with a feature set that rivals more expensive platforms. It’s particularly appealing to budget-conscious marketers who need advanced capabilities without premium costs.

- **AI-Enhanced Tools**: Generate email copy, subject lines, and product descriptions with built-in AI.
- **Visual Workflow Builder**: Create automated sequences with triggers for opens, clicks, purchases, and custom events.
